== Summary ==
Change crop (before) for [[Han Solo (V)]]: the region (260, 844, 580, 892) (x0, y0, x1, y1 in pixels) cut unchanged, without resizing, from the Players Committee card image of [[Han Solo (V) (Playtest)]] (Playtest): [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3d2c89e5f02cee6c39d70bd023260b638f3c0dc1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/hansolo.gif Holotable commit 3d2c89e] (2024-12-26). The matching after crop is [[:File:V24-L-hansolo-2024-12-29-change-crop-after.png]]. Compared with the image of [[Han Solo (V) (Playtest)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3d2c89e5f02cee6c39d70bd023260b638f3c0dc1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/hansolo.gif commit 3d2c89e]) and [[Han Solo (V)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/hansolo.gif commit efc26cd]).
